title: Connected apps
intro: Bring your tools and AI assistants into your CRM. Connect an account, choose its access, and manage it here.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the URL and copy it manually.
emptySearch: No integrations match your search. Try another name or category.
emptyConnections: Your tools, connected in one place
emptyConnectionsBody: Connect an account from the directory to get started. You can review and revoke AI access here too.
adminRequired: An administrator needs to set up this integration.
comingSoon: This integration is on the roadmap. Connecting accounts is not available yet.
slackAccess: Read public channel names and post messages in channels the app has joined. Message history and private channels are not requested.
slackIntro: Connect your Slack workspace, choose a channel, and check that the connection works. Automated deal alerts and message actions are planned separately.
slackSetup: Your server administrator needs to configure the Slack OAuth app before accounts can be connected.
noChannels: Invite the Warpdrive app to a public channel, then reload this list.
disconnectBody: The Slack token will be revoked. Existing CRM records stay available. You can reconnect this workspace later.
requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Try again or ask your administrator.
freshAuthentication: Please sign in again to confirm this security-sensitive change.
forbidden: You do not have permission to make this change.
callbackConnected: Slack is connected. Choose a channel to finish setup.
callbackFailed: Slack could not be connected. Check the app configuration and try again.
gmailBody: Connect or reconnect your Gmail mailbox and manage its sync settings.
mcpBody: Search CRM records, prepare meetings, update deals, create tasks, and draft follow-ups from your AI assistant.
mcpDisabled: AI connections have not been enabled on this server. Ask your administrator to enable the MCP server and configure a public HTTPS address.
mcpAccess: Your assistant acts with your account’s current CRM permissions. Review the requested actions in your AI client. You can revoke access at any time.
chatgptStep1: Open the official ChatGPT setup guide and add a custom MCP server.
chatgptStep2: Enter this server URL, choose OAuth authentication, and sign in to Warpdrive.
chatgptStep3: Review access, connect, and try searching for a deal or creating a task.
claudeStep1: In Claude, open Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector.
claudeStep2: Paste this server URL, connect, and sign in to Warpdrive. Organization approval may be required.
claudeStep3: Enable the connector in a conversation and try a CRM workflow.
otherStep1: Choose a client that supports remote MCP over Streamable HTTP and OAuth with PKCE.
otherStep2: Add this server URL and complete Warpdrive’s authorization screen.
otherStep3: Test a read operation, then review and approve a write operation.
publicEndpoint: Cloud AI clients need a reachable server address. A localhost address is for local clients only.
grantsBody: Review the clients you have authorized and revoke their access when needed.
marketTitle: An ecosystem built around your work
marketBody: The marketplace is the next stage. It will bring reviewed integrations, workflow actions, and CRM extensions together with clear permissions and managed updates.
marketFeature1: Public community apps and private organization apps
marketFeature3: Version compatibility, updates, and safe removal
marketStatus: Marketplace installation is not available in this release.

revocationPending: Disconnected locally. Slack could not confirm revocation. Retry disconnecting to finish removing its access.
slackSetupStep1: Create a Slack app for your workspace and add this redirect URL under OAuth & Permissions.
slackSetupStep2: Add the bot scopes chat:write and channels:read. Invite the app to the public channels you want to use.
slackSetupStep3: Set SLACK_CLIENT_ID and SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET in your server configuration, then restart Warpdrive.
slackSetupStep4: Keep Slack token rotation disabled for this first connector release.
